result.summary: Found 2 issues: a critical content bug showing an untranslated localization key as a section title, and a major layout issue where a restaurant name is truncated.

issues.description: Section heading displays the raw localization/i18n key 'home_feed.popular_title' instead of a human-readable title.
issues.suggestion: Replace the key with the correct translated string (e.g. 'Popular near you') and verify all locale strings are loaded.

issues.description: Restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' is truncated/cut off on the third card in the Fastest near you row.
issues.suggestion: Allow the title to wrap to two lines, use a smaller font, or ensure card width and text overflow (ellipsis) are handled so the full name remains readable.
